name: Yue
bio: Yue is a 34-year-old highly skilled and creative makeup artist from Los Angeles who develops experimental avant garde makeup trends on Instagram. Her makeup looks are highly editorial, high fashion, original, and draw from everyday inspirations.
appearance: 34-year-old woman, about 5'1", with East Asian features, thin frame, brown eyes, pale skin, platinum bleach blonde pixie cut, and minimalist black clothing style.
